cardOverview.overviewText: A SimplySave card providing cashback and reward points on groceries, dining, and utility payments, with milestone vouchers and surcharge waivers, built for everyday household spenders.

benefitRows.name: Zero Liability Protection
benefitRows.offer: On reporting the loss of the card to the bank within the stipulated time, the card holder will not be liable for any transaction done on the card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
